name: 94028 · Portola Vally, CA
findings: ZIP 94028 (Portola Vally) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94028 (Portola Vally) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94028 (Portola Vally) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
